Exact selected archive admits while an owned miniature live checkout has a distinct tracked edit; committed bytes, not edited bytes, reach the candidate.
Owned live untracked shadow module/config does not enter the archive or load receipts; live bytes remain unchanged.
A later owned-miniature HEAD does not replace the explicit original commit/tree/blob inputs.
Changed required archived source/test/package bytes refuse before a phase sentinel.
Missing required source/test/package input refuses; no cached build or loader fallback compensates.
Added live/untracked source/config overlay in the candidate input namespace refuses; explicitly declared separate generated output/native/tool staging is not conflated with source.
An archive from another commit cannot qualify under the selected candidate identity.
Git-bound required-file mode changes are detected rather than silently rebaselined.
Required source-file replacement by an owned symlink outside the candidate refuses, even if the target initially has identical bytes.
A required source ancestor redirected outside the candidate refuses; no write reaches the external owned sentinel.
A harmless miniature phase that changes source or tracked evidence is detected after execution; original expected Git identity remains authoritative.
Exactly the selected 220-input envelope and compact hash are required; old revision, changed/missing input and absent/mismatched required environment bindings refuse.
Native49 authenticate; copied mandatory prerequisite missing/changed/nonexecutable still refuses before launch in each supported mode.
Existing legitimate/old/missing/compiled env-source import controls preserve actual resolve/load receipts and reject fallback; no full product evaluation.
No implicit global ignore-dirty setting; missing/invalid mode preserves strict policy or explicit usage rejection.
Detect blanket dirty bypass with strict-mode control, dropped archive-byte authentication with tamper control, and live-copy substitution with committed/live canaries. Never launch a whole suite.
